name: Classic Rift - Harrowing
creator: thekillerey
description:
The Rift is back. And so am I.

Harrowing Rift brings the Halloween atmosphere of old League of Legends back to Classic Summoner’s Rift. Haunted forests, glowing candles and familiar landmarks welcome you into a world worth remembering.

Whether you played on the old Halloween map or are discovering its atmosphere for the first time—welcome home.

WHAT TO EXPECT

• The nostalgic Harrowing look, restored as a custom map.
• Haunted woodland, Halloween decorations and candlelit paths.
• Atmospheric lighting and a dark, custom night sky.
• A hidden Easter egg for those who pay attention.

Some old friends are still out there. Watch the trailer closely.

REYENGINE

This project was developed with my League of Legends modding editor, ReyEngine. The trailer’s cinematic shots were also captured using its cinematic feature.

You can find ReyEngine through the links on this page.

FEEDBACK & SUPPORT

Found an issue? Reach out through PROJECT: Rey on Discord. Please include your the mod version, any other active mods, and a screenshot or short clip when possible.

CREDITS

Map restoration: TheKillerey
Tools and cinematic capture: ReyEngine (TheKillerey)
Original League of Legends game and map assets: Riot Games
Special thanks: Community <3

Welcome back to Classic Harrowing Rift.
